name: pi-provider-gd
description: Native `gd` pi provider for provider.girard-davila.net (gd API served from api.girard-davila.net): /login gd accepts a pasted API key or browser SSO, key auto-stored, models appear as gd/ with no restart. Self-contained (no pi-provider-litellm).

metadata.description: Native `gd` pi provider for provider.girard-davila.net (gd API served from api.girard-davila.net): /login gd accepts a pasted API key or browser SSO, key auto-stored, models appear as gd/<model-id> with no restart. Self-contained (no pi-provider-litellm).
